# OpenSciEd

> Open-source, NGSS-aligned K-12 science curriculum with phenomenon-based learning and comprehensive professional development for equitable science education.

OpenSciEd provides freely available, peer-reviewed science curriculum materials and teacher professional learning programs designed to support K-12 science instruction. The organization partners with certified distributors and professional learning providers to help educators implement high-quality, standards-aligned science education.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Phenomenon-based learning
- Open educational resources
- Professional development
- Instructional model
- EdReports certification
- Elementary/Middle/High school curriculum
- Teacher Academy: Foundations
- Universal Design for Learning
- Science education equity
- Storyline instruction
- Curriculum implementation
- Computer science integration
- Assessment practices
- On-demand teacher support

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://openscied.org): OpenSciEd homepage introducing open-source science curriculum and EdReports-approved resources.
- [Why OpenSciEd](https://openscied.org/why-openscied): Overview of OpenSciEd's NGSS-aligned, phenomenon-based learning approach and value proposition.
- [The OpenSciEd Difference](https://openscied.org/why-openscied/the-openscied-difference): Comparison of OpenSciEd's instructional design and quality standards versus other curricula.
- [About Us](https://openscied.org/why-openscied/about-us): OpenSciEd organization mission, values, and commitment to equitable science education.

## Curriculum Programs

- [Curriculum Overview](https://openscied.org/curriculum): Overview of OpenSciEd's K-12 NGSS-aligned open educational resource curriculum programs.
- [Elementary School Curriculum](https://openscied.org/curriculum/elementary-school): Elementary K-5 science curriculum with hands-on learning and teacher professional development.
- [Middle School Curriculum](https://openscied.org/curriculum/middle-school): Middle school NGSS-aligned curriculum with computer science integration and adoption guide.
- [High School Curriculum](https://openscied.org/curriculum/high-school): High school biology, chemistry, physics curriculum aligned to NGSS and AP standards.
- [Supplemental Materials](https://openscied.org/curriculum/supplemental-materials): Supplemental resources including simulation library, phenomena videos, and health equity units.

## Professional Learning

- [Professional Learning Overview](https://openscied.org/professional-learning): Professional learning programs for teachers and districts implementing OpenSciEd curriculum.
- [Teacher Professional Learning](https://openscied.org/professional-learning/teachers): Teacher Academy Foundations and on-demand support library for curriculum implementation.
- [District Professional Learning](https://openscied.org/professional-learning/districts): District-level professional learning for sustainable curriculum adoption and instructional coherence.
- [On-Demand Teacher Support Library](https://openscied.org/professional-learning/on-demand-teacher-support): On-demand video resources on storyline instruction, assessment, and universal design for learning.
- [Professional Learning Events](https://openscied.org/professional-learning/events): Summer academies and virtual professional learning events for K-12 science teachers.

## Quality & Design

- [Committed to Quality](https://openscied.org/why-openscied/committed-to-quality): Details on OpenSciEd's peer-review and EdReports quality assurance processes.
- [Instructional Model](https://openscied.org/why-openscied/instructional-model): Explanation of OpenSciEd's phenomenon-based storyline approach and teaching routines.

- [Purchase](https://openscied.org/purchase): Purchasing information for OpenSciEd curriculum materials through certified distributors.
- [Support](https://openscied.org/support): Support resources, knowledge base, and contact information for curriculum and professional learning.
